items.title: Fairmint plans tokenized stock venue on Canton, Ethereum under SEC experiment
items.summary: The firm is the latest to join in building blockchain-based stock markets under the agency’s five-year "innovation exemption" for tokenized trading.

items.title: MoonPay applies for national trust bank charter to expand stablecoin services
items.summary: MoonPay has applied for a national trust bank charter to expand its custody and stablecoin services under federal oversight.

items.title: MoonPay seeks US bank charter for stablecoin, custody services
items.summary: MoonPay’s proposed national trust bank would offer stablecoin issuance and redemption, reserve management and digital asset custody under federal oversight.

items.title: Trump’s SEC nominee Johnson backs formal rulemaking for tokenized stock trading
items.summary: Former CFTC Commissioner and Democrat Kristin Johnson and ex-SEC aide Steven Levine appeared before lawmakers Thursday.

items.title: Citi Says Customers Are Responsible When AI Banking Agents Go Rogue—Even After a Hack
items.summary: Citibank’s updated terms put customers on the hook for outside AI agents, including leaked logins.
